tools.name: list_rooms
tools.description: List the rooms the authenticated account belongs to.

tools.name: list_quick_actions
tools.description: List the quick actions configured for a room.

tools.name: get_live_status

Only returns streams started by this credential, within the last 24 hours. Returns notification_id and correlation_id, then the stored display state (state, progress, mess

tools.name: list_room_icons
tools.description: List the room-icon catalog (icon ids, tags, and categories). Call this before create_room / create_public_room / create_webhook to pick a valid icon id, and to interpret icon values returned by reads.

tools.name: list_notifications
tools.description: List a bounded page of recent pings across approved rooms, newest first. Use page to continue while has_more is true.

tools.name: get_notification
tools.description: Fetch one visible ping by notification id, including its current action_state and, once anything on its data.checklist is checked, checklist_state.

tools.name: wait_for_notification
tools.description: Long-poll for the next ping. Blocks until one arrives or the timeout elapses — the real-time inbound channel for an agent. The agent's own sends are excluded.

tools.name: wait_for_ack
tools.description: Long-poll a generic acknowledgement-required ping until its confirmation rule is met (any: first confirmation; all: every original eligible recipient), it expires, or the timeout elapses. Questions use wait_for_answer instead.

tools.name: request_approval
tools.description: Ask the human to approve or reject an action, then block on their answer (pair with wait_for_approval). Delivered as a push to the connected human only, so like a direct ask_question to them it needs no trigger permission in the room; public and personal rooms are refused. Rate-limited.

tools.name: wait_for_approval
tools.description: Long-poll an approval request until the human decides or it expires. Returns the status and, once decided, the chosen option.

tools.name: get_approval
tools.description: Fetch the current status of an approval request without blocking.

tools.name: ask_question
tools.description: Ask a person a question with 2-4 tappable options, then block on their answer (pair with wait_for_answer). Delivered as a push they can answer from the lock screen or in-app; the first valid answer wins. Rate-limited.

tools.name: wait_for_answer
tools.description: Long-poll a question until it is answered or expires. Returns the state and, once answered, the chosen option value + label and the responder.

tools.name: get_question
tools.description: Fetch the current state of a question without blocking.

tools.name: list_questions
tools.description: List a bounded page of questions you asked, newest first. Optionally filter by state; use page while has_more is true.

tools.name: cancel_question
tools.description: Withdraw a still-pending question you asked.

tools.name: activate_agent_inbox
tools.description: Start or resume the onboarding Question in the private room the human chose during authorization. If recipient_not_ready, ask the human to install or update PingRoom from install_url, open the app, sign in, and enable notifications before retrying. Read question.id, then call wait_for_handoff only w

tools.name: create_handoff
tools.description: Hand work to exactly one human as either an acknowledgement or a tappable question. The server verifies that one of the recipient's current devices supports the complete Handoff action before creating anything.

tools.name: wait_for_handoff
tools.description: Long-poll a Handoff until the human resolves it, it expires, or the bounded timeout elapses. For the onboarding Question returned by activate_agent_inbox, success requires an answered result with activation_completed true; use a bounded local deadline and treat any terminal answer without that stamp

tools.name: get_handoff
tools.description: Fetch the authoritative current state of one Handoff without blocking.

tools.name: list_handoffs
tools.description: List a bounded page of this agent's Handoffs, newest first. Omit state (or use open) for unresolved work; use all for history and page while has_more is true.

tools.name: upload_attachment
tools.description: Upload a small file (max ~90 KiB over MCP; Pro account required) and get an attachment id to include in broadcast or ask_question via attachment_ids. Larger files: use the PingRoom CLI or agent REST API.

tools.name: get_attachment
tools.description: Fetch an attachment visible to this agent as base64 content plus metadata. Results over the connector size limit return attachment_too_large — fetch those via the agent REST API instead.

tools.name: delete_attachment
tools.description: Delete an attachment this agent uploaded that is not yet claimed by a ping.

tools.name: get_room
tools.description: Fetch a single room by its invite code, including members and quick actions.

tools.name: create_room
tools.description: Create a new private room owned by the authenticated account. Free accounts may own up to five rooms. If this agent was granted every room and has no delivery room yet, the new room becomes its delivery room — where its handoffs and direct questions land.

tools.name: create_public_room
tools.description: Create a publicly discoverable room with a unique @handle. Counts toward the free-plan five-room cap.

tools.name: join_room
tools.description: Join a room using its invite code. Include the password only if the room is protected.

tools.name: list_webhooks
tools.description: List the incoming webhooks (with their trigger URLs) for a room the account owns.

tools.name: create_webhook
tools.description: Create an incoming webhook for a room the account owns. The bound account must be Pro. Returns the secret trigger URL — treat it as a credential.

tools.name: update_webhook
tools.description: Update an incoming webhook (by id) on a room the account owns — e.g. change its icon, title, message, or sound.

tools.name: delete_webhook
tools.description: Delete an incoming webhook (by id) from a room the account owns.

tools.name: update_quick_action
tools.description: Configure a numbered quick-action slot for a room the account owns. Sends a background room refresh to room members' devices.

tools.name: update_quick_actions
tools.description: Configure several of a room's quick-action slots in one call. Prefer this over repeated update_quick_action: each single-slot write wakes room members' devices with its own background refresh, so setting up four Pings one at a time spends four of a finite daily push budget on one operation. Slots yo

tools.name: set_avatar
tools.description: Set this agent's avatar. Must be one of the PingRoom bot avatars.

tools.name: rotate_handle
tools.description: Rotate this agent's public handle — kill-switch for a leaked handle.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: trigger_quick_action, broadcast, get_live_status, list_notifications, get_notification, activate_agent_inbox, list_webhooks · Private data: connection_info, disconnect, trigger_quick_action, get_live_status, activate_agent_inbox, upload_attachment, create_room, join_room, create_webhook · Public sink: connection_info, broadcast, upload_attachment, create_webhook, update_webhook, delete_webhook · Destructive: delete_attachment, delete_webhook, rotate_handle.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: trigger_quick_action, broadcast, get_live_status, list_notifications, get_notification, activate_agent_inbox, list_webhooks · Private data: connection_info, disconnect, trigger_quick_action, get_live_status, activate_agent_inbox, upload_attachment, create_room, join_room, create_webhook · Public sink: connection_info, broadcast, upload_attachment, create_webhook, update_webhook, delete_webhook · Destructive: delete_attachment, delete_webhook, rotate_handle

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
